summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FOMO Market Digests subsystem and Calendar polish features. All backend APIs working correctly. CRM digest management fully functional with AI generation and preview. Public site displays digests correctly before Comments section. Calendar cross-through implemented but requires authentication for news articles.

integration_issues.issue: Calendar event 'Read news' button requires authentication to view linked news articles. When clicked without auth, shows 'Sign in to access FOMO AI' modal instead of navigating to news article.
integration_issues.affected_flow: Calendar → Event Modal → Read News cross-through
integration_issues.note: This may be intentional design if news articles require authentication. If public events should link to public news, the relatedArticleId cross-through needs to bypass auth or the event modal should check article visibility.
